evidence: Static walk of all 164 criteria (functional 152, polish 5, visual 5, gates 2) against the frozen golden found no criterion the reference cannot satisfy. Exact-figure checks recomputed by hand against solution/app/src/rules.js:54-70 and seed constants: D1/B1 run-rates 100.00->100.00, basis 105.01->104.02 and 105.01->106.03, signing adjustments -1.98/+2.04, one-cent overrun -0.01 on the destination only (public/js/change-sets.js:184-194 compose, 238-249 footer with 'Over budget by'); P3 tiers 1/2/2/3 (band edges 200000.00/350000.00); P4 A/B/C annualized 1.77/5.53/9.78, 12-month claw 4800.02/7200.03 and 13 units -> 3 retained/10 cancelled (rules.js:105-139); P7 13 months for the Jan-31 anchor and 11/12 around the leap-day anniversary (rules.js:31-48); P6 60.25 consumed/39.75 headroom; P8 cliffs (rules.js:142-151). Desk rows are implemented: pre-save figures and aria-invalid field faults naming member and term (public/js/change-sets.js:199-264), add/remove with 2-4 bounds (116-163), per-user localStorage entries (66-77), focus on saved preview / refusal explanation (263, 294, 334-335), live SSE refresh that patches the desk in place (public/js/app.js:239-295; src/index.js:43-50), server-side freshness mark using the same tests as commit (src/change-sets.js:19-29, 116-126), session-lost prompt (app.js:326-333), no save control for non-Finance (change-sets.js:50-53). Scripted golden evidence, hash-bound to the frozen solution bytes, reports 11/11 live-desk observations, 15/15 coordinated-change API groups and 3/3 repair groups passed with no page errors (806 ms live arrival). MISSING MEASUREMENT (reason for risk=true): no full configured judge run or Oracle score exists for this candidate, and the evidence index itself states the golden has not been scripted through every Functional criterion; the legacy P1-P9 rows rest on code reading only. Visual Likert outcomes are unmeasured. Two latent P3 observations, neither a demonstrated failure: (1) hro_change_receipt (weight 0.25) asks the batch receipt to identify 'compensation', but the receipt card renders run-rate, basis, signing adjustment and equity terms only, not successor base/signing/relocation (public/js/change-sets.js:309-319); those are visible in Offers and in the ordinary product response, which the criterion permits. (2) For a cross-requisition member the audit line prints 'headroom before -> after' using the source requisition before and the destination requisition after (src/index.js:291-303 snapshot/receipt), which a strict judge could question under hro_change_audit (weight 0.25); B1's values are 0.00 on both sides so it does not show there. Weak-app/alternative probe: criteria tell the judge to discover routes and labels, so nothing I walked depends on a golden-private route or selector for the golden to pass.
suggested_fix: No blocking fix. Before clearance, obtain the full configured judge run on the golden (Oracle) so every functional, polish and visual criterion is measured rather than inferred. Optional hardening: render successor base, signing bonus and relocation in the saved preview/receipt card, and label the member audit line's headroom with its requisition ids.
